text:
olga: FYI saw a 3-4x spike in fncall validation rejects on /chat/invoke starting ~10:03 PST. Mostly us-west-2, route=router-v2, variant=short-ctx-degen.
kevin: Any sample logs?
olga: log excerpt: `2026-03-23T17:03:12Z id=abc123 status=validation_reject reason="output_shape_mismatch" details="expected object, got array"`
ashley: Console currently shows a generic 'validation_error' only. We need a `validation_reason` dimension to filter heatmaps.
diana: Finance flagged billing noise 1: some rejects still look billable because tokens are charged on receive.
sre-bot: alert: validation_error_rate for /chat/invoke > 3% in us-west-2 at 17:03:20Z
kevin: Proposal: add fields to invoke_result event: `validation_outcome` (hard_reject|soft_reject|pass), `validation_reason` (stable enum), `validator_version`, plus `route_variant` and `region`. Keep nullable, sample at 5% initially.
olga: Add dynamic override: capture 100% for windows where error_rate > 2% until manual ack.
ashley: UX wants filter for reason, a legend, and one redacted failing sample per reason bucket. Soft_validate mode to collect reasons without rejecting.
diana: Billing plan: exclude events where `validation_outcome==hard_reject` after migration and validator_version >= v1.4.0.
kevin: Canary: enable full tagging for 10% traffic on router-v2-canary for 24h, monitor cardinality & payload size.
console-bot: NOTE: expected index growth ~+2.4GB for 30d at current sampling.
sre-bot: Ops checklist: alert update, sampling override, runbook note.
kevin: Action owners: runtime/emitter PR (kevin) by EOD tomorrow, canary config (olga), console index + mocks (ashley), billing rule draft (diana).
olga: I'll grep for recent failing examples and attach redacted snippets.
kevin: Tests: enforce enum-only `validation_reason` and disallow free text.
ashley: Sync in 11am triage. If spike reappears, ping #incidents. :thumbsup:
olga: thanks all.
